one_offs.what: a reversal of a withholding tax provision

driver_class.Cost of devices, equipment and software: imported handsets and equipment; dollar-denominated under a pegged riyal, so the driver is device volume and world equipment prices rather than domestic inflation
driver_class.Network access charges: interconnection and wholesale capacity; volume-linked and regulated, with no disclosed unit rate
driver_class.Government charges: a regulated levy; note 35 breaks it out further and it runs about 7% of revenue
driver_class.Employees costs: domestic wages; the one line the Saudi inflation ladder governs directly
driver_class.Repairs and maintenance: the asset base being maintained, so it belongs with the capital-intensity question rather than with revenue
driver_class.Amortisation and impairment of contract: contract acquisition costs amortised over contract life; a subscriber-acquisition driver
driver_class.Others: stc Bank direct cost, postage and delivery, and utilities per the note; a residual with no single driver

ebitda_finding: The REPORTED EBITDA margin rises then dips, 31.27%, 31.56%, 31.44%. With the two named reversals put back and the credit-loss charge held at its own three-year mean it RISES STEADILY: 29.95%, 30.36%, 30.97%, about fifty basis points a year. THE REBUILT MODEL OPENS AT 31.09%, twelve basis points above the normalised base year and thirty-five below the reported one — so once the one-offs are classified the forecast margin is well anchored, which is a validation of the rebuild rather than a defect in it. It is also the only reading under which the anchor rule can be applied honestly, because the reported series it would otherwise be measured against is moved by items the filings themselves call non-recurring.
finding: The REPORTED gross margin dips and recovers, 48.40%, 49.18%, 48.45%. With the two disclosed reversals put back it RISES: 47.39%, 47.20%, 48.45%. The model holds FY2025 flat, and FY2025 is the HIGHEST of the three on the underlying basis — so that assumption sits at the optimistic end of this record rather than the cautious one.
